posts.text:
Democrats are going to force Senate Republicans to vote on amendment after amendment about Trump’s ballroom, about Trump’s corrupt slush fund, and the rising costs of Trump’s war.

They will not be able to hide.

Barney Frank and I came to Congress together. The minute he got here, he was a fountain of energy, intelligence, morality, and creativity – all aimed at making the world a better place. He never stopped and has had an amazing impact.

We remained good friends after he retired, and we would continually discuss his plethora of incredible ideas to improve this country and this world that he loved so much. I will miss him as a friend, and the world will miss him as a great humanitarian leader.

Trump’s DOJ granted him and his family immunity from tax audits, giving his family a license to commit tax fraud.

Trump doesn’t have to pay his taxes. Meanwhile he’s using American tax dollars to line the pockets of his family and his far-right cronies.

This is what Donald Trump had to say about Americans dealing with surging gas prices⬇️


Aaron Rupar (@atrupar)

Trump on high gas prices: "This is peanuts. I appreciate everybody putting up with it for a little while. But I don't even think about. What I think about is you can't let Iran have a nuclear weapon."

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/atrupar/status/2056752936584114197#m

Trump says his billion-dollar, gold-plated ballroom is “a gift to the United States of America.”

Let’s call it what it is: an insult to every American struggling to make ends meet.

While Democrats are fighting to lower costs, Republicans are fighting like hell to spend billions in taxpayer dollars on Trump's ballroom.

Who’s having the worst week? Senate Republicans or Donald Trump?
 
Hard to say when it’s only Wednesday and they’re all in a downward spiral where every day feels like a new rock bottom.

Video

I’m launching Senate Democrats’ Election Protection Task Force to prevent, monitor, and challenge any malfeasance from Donald Trump and the far-right before, during, and after our elections in November.

Our task force is bringing together 11 senators and some of the sharpest elections experts in the country to safeguard our democracy.

Video

Trump negotiated a get out of jail free card with himself.

Video

We are praying for the families of the victims of yesterday’s heinous mass shooting which killed three people at the Islamic Center of San Diego – the city’s largest mosque.

One of the victims was a security guard and father of eight – Amin Abdullah – who was killed while preventing the gunmen from entering the building.

His heroic actions surely saved many lives, and we will always owe him and his family a debt of gratitude.

We must condemn islamophobia and all forms of hate in the loudest o

For the EIGHTH time, we will be bringing our War Powers Resolution to the floor to end Trump’s war with Iran.

Republicans have a choice to stop catering to Trump and end this deeply unpopular war. They must vote yes.

Donald Trump thinks the federal government is his personal slush fund.

Nearly 2 BILLION dollars for his MAGA slush fund, a billion more for his gilded ballroom, and NOT ONE serious plan to lower costs for the families forced to pay the bill.

Democrats are fighting to lower costs. Republicans are fighting to launder Trump’s corruption through the federal budget. That’s the difference.

Trump is doing more for Russia’s war machine and Putin’s profits than he is for the American people struggling with soaring gas prices.

Putin remains one of the biggest winners in Trump’s costly, reckless, and illegal war with Iran.


POLITICOEurope (@POLITICOEurope)

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has said he will extend a temporary pause of U.S. sanctions on Russian oil exports until mid-June. politico.eu/article/us-pause…




— https://nitter.net/POLITICOEurope/status/2056428144677073321#m

This week, for the EIGHTH time, @SenateDems are forcing a vote on our War Powers Resolution to withdraw our troops from hostilities with Iran.

@SenateGOP:

Support our War Powers Resolution. End the war. Get our troops out of harm’s way.

Video

Trump returned from China with nothing to show for it besides a photo op with Xi Jinping

—No action to stop the flow of fentanyl
—No protections for US manufacturers
—Continued CCP ownership of US farmland
—More doubt on our commitment to Taiwan
—Zero effort to protect our lead in the AI & semiconductor race

Trump pardoned violent insurrectionists who assaulted YOUR Capitol to overturn YOUR votes.

And now he wants to give them YOUR hard-earned tax dollars as a reward.


The New York Times (@nytimes)

Breaking News: The Justice Dept. announced a $1.8 billion fund to pay President Trump’s allies as part of its settlement with the IRS. Follow live updates. nyti.ms/3RNhnYh




— https://nitter.net/nytimes/status/2056408125704429929#m

Democrats derailed the GOP’s ridiculous ballroom proposal, and now they're scrambling to come up with a new ballroom provision to put into their bill.

They won't work this hard to lower your costs, but they work overtime to protect Trump’s vanity project.

I am praying for those injured and the security guard killed at the San Diego Islamic Center, and am grateful to law enforcement for their quick response and action to neutralize the suspects.

We must do everything we can to keep people safe at houses of worship and keep children safe in our schools. There is no place in our country for this type of violence at mosques, synagogues, churches, or anywhere else. I will continue to follow the situation closely and hope for the full recovery of all

As Trump’s DOL moves to rip away critical overtime protections for millions of workers, I am co-leading a bill to undo that damage and instead expand overtime for hardworking Americans.

The Restoring Overtime Pay Act expands and strengthens overtime protections, putting more money in the pockets of almost 30 million workers by gradually increasing the overtime salary threshold.

Congress must pass this bill immediately to ensure that American workers get the compensation they have earned.


AFL
